title: NASA Publications (continued)
slide_intent: Teach editors to choose inks, paper and page format with the constraints of printing and reading in mind.
strategic_value: NASA can maintain a family of publications across different budgets by stating which production choices can vary.
demonstration: The text continues the typography guidance, then moves through Color, Paper, Sizes and Formats. The page distinguishes one-color, two-color and special process-printing uses.
practical_value: For a two-color job, select the second ink according to the work it must do: accent the identity, distinguish information or deepen a photographic duotone.

content_islands.name: Typography and ink choices
content_islands.spec: Continue the prior page in three narrow columns without adding a new display heading. Introduce Color in the first column and carry the printing options into the second.

content_islands.name: Paper and sizes
content_islands.spec: Set Paper and Sizes as short subheads in the middle column. Let the discussion of standard sizes continue into the last column.

content_islands.name: Format guidance
content_islands.spec: Finish in the right column with the vertical-format recommendation for booklets and brochures and the route for exceptions.
